name: Outbound agent
oneLiner: Turns a week of raw prospects into the twenty accounts to call on Monday, and says why.
problem: A sales team receives hundreds of raw prospects every week and has to decide who to call on Monday. The signals that matter, timing and need, sit in different places, and reading them all by hand takes the week.
built: A 100-point score: timing 45, need 35, fit 20. The model reads and writes, the rules decide.
No prospect is thrown away: each one goes to prospecting, an account manager, nurturing, or out, with its reason.
A Monday brief: the top 20 with why now, the angle, who to call and the opening line.
A web app to rerun it every week and ask questions about the run.
proof: About 466 raw prospects scored and routed
Built for the final round at Tamtam: got the offer
cardProof: ~466 raw prospects scored · Got the offer
